result.reason: Although the added language facially reaches the fallback by providing a mutual 12-month-fees cap, mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, and the required carve-outs, the retained provisions materially conflict with it. They continue to disclaim virtually all Licensor liability, require Licensee to assume all system-related liabilities and risks, limit Licensor exposure to direct damages arising from gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and disclaim IP-infringement liability. Those provisions undermine mutuality and may eliminate liability for the stated confidentiality, indemnity, security, fraud, and IP carve-outs. The unnecessary relocation of the existing text and the resulting contradictory, poorly structured clause also make the redline non-minimal and professionally deficient. The margin comment does not cure these operative defects.
